flow_summary: The interviewer repeatedly failed to recover vague or disorganised answers from the confused patient (e.g., name, DOB, full address) and moved on without clarification or breakdown. It asked follow-up questions assuming a biological treatment existed after the patient clearly said “I don’t know of any, no,” and posed redundant employment questions after the patient stated there were no other jobs. PHQ-9/GAD-7 items were asked once each with no safety flag needed.
